entities.summary: Jenni Pitko is a Finnish politician currently serving in the Parliament of Finland for the Green League at the Oulu constituency. She was first elected to parliament in 2019. Previously, she served on the Oulu city council. Prior to becoming a politician Pitko studied at the University of Oulu and worked as an architect.
